rationale: Parth brings hands-on hardware testing experience from Tesla's TeslaBot humanoid robotics program, while Rohin is building in robotics manipulation as founder of Posha. Their complementary expertise—Parth's mechanical and hardware validation background paired with Rohin's domain focus and C++ development—could create value in discussing real-world testing, reliability, and integration challenges in applied robotics.
intro_message: Parth Behani, meet Rohin Malhotra — Parth's hardware testing work on humanoid robots at Tesla complements Rohin's robotics manipulation focus at Posha, and they could swap insights on bringing robotic systems to reliability.
